column1: # The patch revisions that changed what a match computes (the simulation),
# oldest first. A game plays a replay only when every game of its recording
# was of the last one's revision or later: a recording of older games plays
# out otherwise in a newer one (session::v026g::replays, read at build time;
# A PR whose change makes a match play out otherwise (an exe patch of the
# game's rules, what a kit or a respawn is, ...) adds the row
# at the end: a PR never knows its revision. The release that ships it is
# that revision: its server takes `next` for its SRP_MIN_PATCH_REVISION
# (the release's own, set at its swap), and release/release.sh writes the
# number in place of `next` in its record. One `next` row at most: a second
# simulation change before the release adds its words to that row.

a world takes no player input whose rotation no client makes (exe patch 99, 0.27d's "input is invalid"): game_world_core::change_input<player_input> 0x1FAB50 refuses, for every input (local, relayed, moved, a replay's), one whose half2 rotation has a half that is a NaN, an infinity or 1024 radians or more (the match server's PlayerInput::rotation_is_sane), returning 6 with nothing kept, so a world given one plays out without it; bullets hit players where they stood when crossed (the owner, 2026-11-05; exe patch 103): at a grid step each player near a bullet's ray is tested where he stood at the ms the bullet reached him (the game's hit time of the ray's point nearest his middle), put back along his character controller's last step (m_last_pos to its position) by the share of the step since then, at most that step's move; translation only; not the dead or those spawned in the step; the level tested as before, the closest hit winning (ties: the level, then the lower place); with no player moving near the ray the game's result (docs/notes/subtick_bullet_hits.md); a bullet's hit is rewound to what its shooter saw (exe patch 105, past_poses): each place's player state ends with a record (rewind::Record, 73 bytes after patch 78's carry: the place's feet at the last four grid points, written at atomic_tick's end on the grid, and the age its shots are declared with); a kit-choice byte of 3 to 13 (0xDE/0xF3) declares an age 0..150 ms for every target, in force for the place's shots fired after its tick; patch 103's test puts each target back by the crossing's ms (at most the step) and that age, capped by the match (srp block tag 3, default 150), from the step's start along the ring
